connector.name: MCP by translatize.com
connector.registryDescription: Read, search, edit and branch Translatize translation labels and fill missing translations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.translatize. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRANSLATIZE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Translatize integration API token (an "mcni_..." string), bound to one project and branch. Create it under Project Settings -> Integrations at https://app.translatize.com.

env.name: TRANSLATIZE_API_URL
env.description: API base URL including the /v1 segment. Defaults to https://api.translatize.com/v1.

env.name: TRANSLATIZE_APP_URL
env.description: Web-app base URL used to build review links. Defaults to https://app.translatize.com.
